schemaFunctions.$comment: onCreate TEMPLATE — the complete add-handler dialog. repeatable:true (one instance per file format). The content parameter is kind=VARIANT: selecting a format swaps the whole content sub-form and the emitted function name (functionName). CSV/JSON/XML support data binding + streaming via PayloadShape modifiers; TEXT is plain string; RAW is byte[] streamable. fileInfo and caller are optional advanced params gated by emitWhen.
